detail.body:
## Overview

Add direct FP8 K/V up-projection to AITER FlyDSL cached-context attention for ROCm MLA. Eligible cached chunks avoid the expanded BF16 K/V buffer and the separate BF16-to-FP8 conversion pass.

## Claims

- Compressed FP8 cache and native per-channel FP8 `kv_b_proj` weights feed AITER's projection kernel, with FP32 accumulation and direct FP8 K/V output for FP8 FMHA.
- Disabled by default. Requires `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FLYDSL_FP8_PREFILL_ATTN=1` and explicit `kv_b_proj: fp8_per_channel` weight configuration; the attention flag does not quantize model weights.

## Validation

**Revision scope:** full performance and model-accuracy results below validate **`492080779e9feea19308092b0aba0840e87c6115`**. Current head **`e2393d702a3736dffdfbfc7eb25abbabe484a1df`** restores ASM for uncached prefill and removes the two unrelated metadata synchronization fixes. Current-head static checks, eight FP8 kernel cases and the uncached-ASM layer regression passed. Current-head serving, model accuracy and matched performance validation remain outstanding.

**Native performance — Kimi-K3, C48, eight MI355X, TP8/DCP8.** Full agentic replay with a configured 3,600-second duration, normal routing/graphs, 8,192-token chunks, prefix caching and CPU KV offload. DSpark speculative decoding uses four draft tokens and synthetic acceptance length 3.36.

Total throughput counts **successful-request input plus output tokens, divided by elapsed benchmark time and eight GPUs**. Input counts include cached prompt tokens. Output-only throughput is shown separately.

| Pinned container nightly | Total tokens/s/GPU | Output tokens/s/GPU | Measured request errors | Evidence |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| `edad8b03` | 18,244.04135 | 126.79649 | 11/3,834 | [41413372088](https://github.com/ajith-sirra-amd/InferenceMAX_Rocm_Team/actions/runs/41413372088) |
| `e0d00e4b` | **18,276.23099** | **126.80246** | 6/3,840 | [41447686785](https://github.com/ajith-sirra-amd/InferenceMAX_Rocm_Team/actions/runs/41447686785) |

Both replays verified direct FP8 projection and cached FMHA on all eight workers, with 100% TTFT/ITL metric coverage. Each configuration was measured once; variability is unmeasured. A matched native control is not reported, so these are absolute throughput results. The 0.18% difference does not establish an uplift from the container update or BLAS selection.

The earlier replay had ten empty-content responses and one request-body write failure; the newer replay had five and one, respectively. Causes remain unestablished. Eight/nine additional requests were cancelled at the configured cutoff. No server runtime errors or BLAS warnings were detected in the inspected logs.

The subsequent [C56 replay](https://github.com/ajith-sirra-amd/InferenceMAX_Rocm_Team/actions/runs/41485661453), also at `492080779`, failed with an ALLGATHER timeout and TTFT/ITL coverage of 82.4%/82.6%. Its partial throughput is excluded from performance comparisons. The cause remains unestablished; the dependent C96 run did not reach GPU execution.

**Accuracy and implementation checks** (revision noted for each result; GPU/model results are at `492080779`):

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| [GPU kernel tests](https://github.com/ajith-sirra-amd/InferenceMAX_Rocm_Team/actions/runs/41401317715) | **8 passed, zero failures/skips.** Quantization, plain/shuffled projection, FMHA output/LSE, changed-input graph replay, native weight layouts and forward-state cleanup. |
| [Full GSM8K, earlier container](https://github.com/ajith-sirra-amd/InferenceMAX_Rocm_Team/actions/runs/41426504427) | **96.6641% strict / 96.5883% flexible**, all 1,319 examples. |
| [Full GSM8K, newer container — attempt 2](https://github.com/ajith-sirra-amd/InferenceMAX_Rocm_Team/actions/runs/41447950940/attempts/2) | **1,276/1,319 strict (96.7400%) / 1,275/1,319 flexible (96.6641%)**. No detected server errors. |
| [Independent static checks and rendered docs](https://github.com/ajith-sirra-amd/vllm/actions/runs/41442476770) | Ruff, formatting, applicable pre-commit/mypy, exact changed-source comparison and strict MkDocs/rendered usage checks passed for the validated revision. |
| [Current-head static checks](https://github.com/ajith-sirra-amd/vllm/actions/runs/41819725072) | Ruff, formatting, applicable pre-commit hooks, quantizer call-site audit and exact source comparison passed at `e2393d70`. Current-head rendered-docs validation remains separate. |
| [Current-head GPU kernels](https://github.com/ajith-sirra-amd/InferenceMAX_Rocm_Team/actions/runs/41820076564) | **8 passed, zero failures/skips** at `e2393d70`. The enclosing diagnostic workflow failed in additional checks; its kernel-test result is recorded separately. |
| [Uncached ASM regression](https://github.com/ajith-sirra-amd/InferenceMAX_Rocm_Team/actions/runs/41821548931) | Real MLA layer, metadata builder and `forward_mha`: old backend fails with missing ASM metadata; `e2393d70` executes ASM and passes the existing reference tolerance (maximum absolute error 0.02155). Single rank, 12 heads, 128 tokens. The enclosing workflow remains failed due to two additional outlier accuracy cases. |

GSM8K used five-shot, temperature zero, C48/TP8/DCP8, eager execution and 512-token chunks. DSpark used real block verification with nonzero accepted draft tokens. Explicit accuracy-stress routing exercised cached FP8 attention on short prompts; `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error` remained enabled. Direct FP8 projection and cached FMHA were verified on eight workers, with installed source hashes matching the validated revision. These evaluations included the metadata synchronization fixes now separated from this PR. They establish results for that configuration; a matched BF16 accuracy control and normal-routing accuracy evaluation are not reported. The newer run's first attempt failed in its prerequisite watcher before GPU evaluation.

**Historical prototype performance — C48, eight MI355X, TP8/DCP8; total input plus output tokens/s/GPU:**

| Historical configuration | Total tokens/s/GPU | Evidence |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Baseline recipe | 15,476.46881 | [39239112271](https://github.com/ajith-sirra-amd/InferenceMAX_Rocm_Team/actions/runs/39239112271/job/118015427785) |
| FP8 FMHA with BF16 K/V projection | 16,915.72154 | [40646139769](https://github.com/ajith-sirra-amd/InferenceMAX_Rocm_Team/actions/runs/40646139769) |
| Direct FP8 K/V projection + FP8 FMHA | 17,406.08912 | [40695099743](https://github.com/ajith-sirra-amd/InferenceMAX_Rocm_Team/actions/runs/40695099743) |

These are prototype measurements on the `1b2a66639` container, with synthetic speculative acceptance, one replay per configuration. The baseline quantized only `*in_proj_qkvgfab` through the online quantization configuration; later recipes also quantized other attention/MLP projections. The final step additionally quantized `kv_b_proj` and produced a **2.90% observed throughput increase** over the preceding prototype. These rows do not isolate the native PR's speedup or all intervening changes.

Compared with #59124, this PR adds direct FP8 cached-K/V up-projection. The [reference replay](https://github.com/ajith-sirra-amd/InferenceMAX_Rocm_Team/actions/runs/41443951889) failed with collective timeouts, so no performance comparison is reported.

**Upstream checks:** DCO passed at `e2393d70`. The [contributor-authorization gate](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/actions/runs/41822182813/job/126547776319) failed before pre-commit execution; pre-commit and Check format were skipped. Independent fork checks do not replace upstream CI.

## Details

Use `ROCM_AITER_MLA` with `--attention-config '{"mla_prefill_backend":"ROCM_AITER_FA"}'`, BF16 activations, E4M3 KV cache and `--quantization-config '{"targets":{"*.self_attn.kv_b_proj":"fp8_per_channel"}}'`. Requires gfx950, DCP >1, MLA dimensions latent/NoPE/RoPE/value = 512/128/64/128 and compatible AITER/FlyDSL APIs. Unsupported configurations fail during weight initialization; batch invariance is unsupported. [Usage and requirements](https://github.com/ajith-sirra-amd/vllm/blob/e2393d702a3736dffdfbfc7eb25abbabe484a1df/docs/configuration/env_vars.md#rocm-flydsl-fp8-mla-prefill).

Eligible cached chunks have maximum query length >=512 and context length >=8192. Within an eligible forward, smaller cached chunks use FP8 projection inputs with BF16 K/V output and the existing attention backend. Calls outside the supported routing/indexing conditions retain the standard path. Prefills without cached context retain ASM prefill and its metadata allocation; speculative draft attention routing is preserved.

The weight adapter views native per-channel FP8 storage and FP32 descales without re-quantizing or repacking. Q uses dynamic per-tensor E4M3 quantization, with reuse restricted to matching pointer/shape/stride within one layer's forward. Cached K/V output descales are estimated from new-token maxima: `2 * max(new_token_amax / 448, 1e-6)`. FMHA returns BF16 output and natural-log LSE for native merging. The two unrelated metadata-copy fixes are isolated on [a separate branch](https://github.com/ajith-sirra-amd/vllm/tree/fix/mla-metadata-async-copy-20261104) and are absent from this PR's diff; separate sync-fix validation is pending.

**Numerical limits:** same-quantized-input arithmetic tests passed. A separate captured-input BF16 diagnostic measured a historical maximum absolute LSE difference of about **0.935**, above the investigation's **0.20** threshold. This was an additional diagnostic, not a prescribed upstream acceptance rule. Cached outliers can saturate the range estimated from new-token values. GSM8K results do not establish BF16 numerical equivalence. A [constructed-outlier diagnostic](https://github.com/ajith-sirra-amd/InferenceMAX_Rocm_Team/actions/runs/41821548931) confirmed saturation with the current 2x new-token estimate. Measuring cached maxima removed clipping and projection reconstruction error in those cases; it used an extra BF16 projection and is not integrated into serving. Two cached-max cases still exceeded the additional output tolerance (0.003803 absolute error); that case is consistent with AITER's internal FP8 softmax-probability rounding. The diagnostic remains failed, and cache-scale handling remains under review. Rotation/scaling experiments that failed this diagnostic are excluded. [Investigation](https://github.com/ajith-sirra-amd/InferenceMAX_Rocm_Team/blob/checks/native-fp8-binary-scale-20261102/docs/kimi/native-lse-correction-2026-11-02.md).

The native runs installed source revision `492080779` with precompiled vLLM binaries from `a1cfd2c1` inside the pinned containers; the container tag is not the tested vLLM source revision. Full commands, image digests, source manifests and execution proofs are in the linked run artifacts. The harness also quantizes other linear layers and sets `TORCH_BLAS_PREFER_HIPBLASLT=0` and `TORCH_BLAS_PREFER_CUBLASLT=0` for an independently reproduced BF16 BLAS issue. This PR does not override the global BLAS backend. [Runtime evidence](https://github.com/ajith-sirra-amd/InferenceMAX_Rocm_Team/blob/perf/kimi-attnfp8-kv-allgather-20261021/docs/kimi/native-runtime-validation-2026-11-02.md).

Reproduce the native kernel tests:

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -v -s \
    tests/kernels/attention/test_rocm_aiter_mla_prefill_fusions.py -k flydsl_fp8
```

The tests are wired into the MI355 MLA Buildkite step. The additional-environment-variable discussion remains open.

AI assistance was used to prepare the code, tests and description. Human review and upstream CI remain required before merge.

     Most vLLM-specific environment variables are prefixed with `VLLM_` (a handful of standard names — for example `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES`, `MAX_JOBS`, `S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID`/`S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`/`S3_ENDPOINT_URL`, `DO_NOT_TRACK`, `NO_COLOR` — are also read directly when set). **Special care should be taken for Kubernetes users**: please do not name the service as `vllm`, otherwise environment variables set by Kubernetes might conflict with vLLM's environment variables, because [Kubernetes sets environment variables for each service with the capitalized service name as the prefix](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#environment-variables).
 
+## ROCm FlyDSL FP8 MLA prefill
+
+Set `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FLYDSL_FP8_PREFILL_ATTN=1` to opt in to direct
+FP8 K/V projection and cached-context attention on MI355X (gfx950).
+The default is `0`.
+
+This path requires `ROCM_AITER_MLA` with `ROCM_AITER_FA` prefill,
+decode context parallelism greater than one, BF16 activations, an FP8 E4M3
+KV cache, and MLA dimensions latent/NoPE/RoPE/value = 512/128/64/128.
+Select native per-channel FP8 quantization for `kv_b_proj` explicitly;
+the attention flag does not change weight quantization.
+
+For example:
+
+```bash
+export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1
+export VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FLYDSL_FP8_PREFILL_ATTN=1
+vllm serve moonshotai/Kimi-K3 \
+    --trust-remote-code \
+    --dtype bfloat16 \
+    --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
+    --decode-context-parallel-size 8 \
+    --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
+    --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_MLA \
+    --attention-config '{"mla_prefill_backend":"ROCM_AITER_FA"}' \
+    --quantization-config '{"targets":{"*.self_attn.kv_b_proj":"fp8_per_channel"}}'
+```
+
+AITER must expose `gather_kv_b_proj_flydsl` with FP8 output descales and
+`flydsl_flash_attn_fp8_func` (available in AITER v0.1.26), with its compatible
+FlyDSL package installed. Unsupported model dimensions, cache formats, weight
+layouts, or missing kernel APIs fail during weight initialization.
+Batch invariance is unsupported. Other prefill backends do not use this path.
+
+Cached chunks use FP8 FMHA when the maximum query length is at least 512 and
+the maximum context length is at least 8192. Smaller chunks retain BF16
+attention. Calls exceeding the kernels' 32-bit indexing limits use the
+standard path. Prefills without cached context retain the existing ASM
+attention path and its metadata allocation. Within cached-context forwards,
+new-token causal attention retains the existing BF16 path. Speculative draft
+models retain their existing attention routing.
+
+The context projection consumes compressed FP8 cache and FP8 weights directly,
+with FP32 accumulation, and writes FP8 K/V without a BF16 intermediate.
+Q uses dynamic per-tensor quantization. K/V output descales are computed from
+the current new-token K/V maxima with a factor of two headroom and a positive
+scale floor. Reuse is limited to the current layer's forward; distinct Q slices
+are quantized independently. FMHA returns BF16 output and natural-log LSE for
+the existing context/new-token merge.
+
+This is an experimental numerical path: cached values can exceed the
+new-token-derived range and saturate. Validate model accuracy and performance
+on the intended workload before enabling it in production.

+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.rocm_aiter_mla_fp8_quant import (

+            q.zero_()

+            amax = x.float().abs().amax() if tokens else x.new_zeros(()).float()

+    from aiter.ops.shuffle import shuffle_weight

+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention.mla_attention import (

+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.rocm_aiter_mla_fp8_prefill import (

+        ProjectionWeight,
+        project,

+    device = torch.device("cuda")
+    heads = 12
+    cache = torch.randn(512, 576, device=device).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    cache_scale = torch.tensor([0.25], device=device)
+    indices = torch.randperm(512, device=device)[:386].to(torch.int32)
+    weight = torch.randn(heads * 256, 512, device=device).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)

+        weight_scale,
+        preshuffled,
+    )
+    q = torch.randn(20, heads, 192, device=device, dtype=DTYPE) * 2
+    new_k = torch.randn_like(q) * 2
+    new_v = torch.randn(20, heads, 128, device=device, dtype=DTYPE) * 3
+    chunk = MLACommonPrefillMetadata.ContextChunk(

+        request_slice=slice(0, 2),
+        token_slice=slice(0, 20),
+        continuation_token_end=0,
+        is_continuation=False,
+        num_context_tokens=386,
+        query_start_loc=torch.tensor([0, 7, 20], device=device, dtype=torch.int32),
+        max_query_len=13,
+        cu_seq_lens=torch.tensor([0, 129, 386], device=device, dtype=torch.int32),
+        starts=torch.zeros(2, device=device, dtype=torch.int32),
+        max_seq_len=257,
+        seq_lens=torch.tensor([129, 257], device=device, dtype=torch.int32),
+        token_to_seq=torch.repeat_interleave(
+            torch.arange(2, device=device, dtype=torch.int32),
+            torch.tensor([129, 257], device=device),
+        ),
+        all_rows_active=True,
+    )

+        state.prepare(q, new_k, new_v)
+        kv8 = project(cache, cache_scale, indices, params, heads, state.gather_scales)
+        output, lse = state.run(chunk, q, kv8, SCALE)
+        key = (q.data_ptr(), tuple(q.shape), tuple(q.stride()))
+        q8, qs = state.queries[key]
+        return output, lse, q8, qs, kv8
+

+        output, lse, q8, qs, (k8, v8, ks, vs) = result
+        assert k8.dtype == v8.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn
+        # Keep the FP64 oracle independent of the GPU BLAS implementation.
+        latent = cache.cpu().double()[indices.cpu().long()] * cache_scale.cpu().double()
+        expanded = (
+            latent[:, :512]
+            @ (weight.cpu().double() * weight_scale.cpu().double()[:, None]).t()
+        ).view(-1, heads, 256)
+        expected_k = torch.cat(
+            (expanded[..., :128], latent[:, None, 512:].expand(-1, heads, -1)),
+            dim=-1,
+        )
+        for value, expected, descale in (
+            (k8, expected_k, ks),
+            (v8, expanded[..., 128:], vs),
+        ):
+            error = value.cpu().double() * descale.cpu().double() - expected
+            assert torch.isfinite(error).all()
+            assert error.square().mean().sqrt() / expected.square().mean().sqrt() < 0.04
+            assert error.abs().max() / expected.abs().max() < 0.07
+            assert torch.all(expected.abs() <= 448 * descale.cpu().double())
+        qf = q8.cpu().double() * qs.cpu().double()
+        kf = k8.cpu().double() * ks.cpu().double()
+        vf = v8.cpu().double() * vs.cpu().double()
+        for qslice, kslice in (
+            (slice(0, 7), slice(0, 129)),
+            (slice(7, 20), slice(129, 386)),
+        ):
+            logits = torch.einsum("qhd,khd->hqk", qf[qslice], kf[kslice]) * SCALE
+            expected_out = torch.einsum("hqk,khd->qhd", logits.softmax(-1), vf[kslice])
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                output[qslice].cpu().double(), expected_out, atol=2e-3, rtol=2e-3
+            )
+            torch.testing.assert_close(

+            )

+)

+    RowWiseTorchFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel,
+)

+    accumulate_mla_context_chunk,
+    init_mla_context_partial,
+)

+from vllm.v1.attention.ops.rocm_aiter_mla_prefill import gather_compressed_context

+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ProjectionWeight:
+    weight: torch.Tensor
+    scale: torch.Tensor
+    preshuffled: bool
+
+
+def projection_weight(layer: torch.nn.Module, heads: int) -> ProjectionWeight:
+    """Return views only. Never re-quantize, repack, or alter the native layer."""
+    method = layer.quant_method
+    if type(method) is not Fp8PtpcOnlineLinearMethod:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "FP8 projection requires native fp8_per_channel online quantization"
+        )
+    kernel = type(method.fp8_linear)
+    weight, scale = layer.weight, layer.weight_scale
+    if kernel is AiterHipbMMPerTokenFp8ScaledMMLinearKernel:
+        # Native hipb_mm stores a transposed VIEW of shuffled [N,K].
+        # Transpose back before any contiguous operation.
+        weight = weight.t()
+        preshuffled = True
+    elif kernel is AiterPreshuffledPerTokenFp8ScaledMMLinearKernel:
+        preshuffled = True
+    elif kernel is AiterPerTokenFp8ScaledMMLinearKernel:
+        preshuffled = False
+    elif kernel is RowWiseTorchFP8ScaledMMLinearKernel:
+        weight = weight.t()
+        preshuffled = False
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported FP8 projection weight layout: {kernel.__name__}")
+    if (
+        weight.dtype != torch.float8_e4m3fn
+        or weight.shape != (heads * 256, 512)
+        or not weight.is_contiguous()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Expected contiguous OCP E4M3 [heads*256,512] projection storage"
+        )
+    if (
+        scale.dtype != torch.float32
+        or scale.numel() != heads * 256
+        or not scale.is_contiguous()
+        or scale.device != weight.device
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Expected contiguous FP32 per-output-channel descales")
+    if not weight.is_cuda or getattr(layer, "bias", None) is not None:
+        raise ValueError("FP8 projection requires GPU weights without bias")
+    return ProjectionWeight(weight, scale.view(-1), preshuffled)
+
+
+def project(gathered, cache_scale, indices, params, heads, output_scales=None):
+    """FP8 cache x FP8 weight, FP32 accumulation, direct FP8 or BF16 output."""
+    from aiter.ops.flydsl.gather_kv_b_proj import gather_kv_b_proj_flydsl
+
+    if (
+        gathered.ndim != 2
+        or gathered.shape[1] != 576
+        or gathered.dtype != torch.float8_e4m3fn
+        or not gathered.is_contiguous()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Expected contiguous OCP E4M3 cache [rows,576]")
+    if indices.ndim != 1 or indices.dtype != torch.int32 or not indices.is_contiguous():
+        raise ValueError("Expected contiguous int32 cache row indices")
+    if (
+        cache_scale.dtype != torch.float32
+        or cache_scale.numel() != 1
+        or not cache_scale.is_contiguous()
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Expected scalar FP32 cache descale")
+    tensors = [cache_scale, indices, params.weight, params.scale]
+    if output_scales is not None:
+        if (
+            output_scales.dtype != torch.float32
+            or output_scales.shape != (2,)
+            or not output_scales.is_contiguous()
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("Expected contiguous FP32 [K,V] output descales")
+        tensors.append(output_scales)
+    if not gathered.is_cuda or any(t.device != gathered.device for t in tensors):
+        raise ValueError("All projection tensors must share a GPU")
+    dtype = torch.bfloat16 if output_scales is None else torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    with torch.accelerator.device_index(gathered.device.index):
+        k = torch.empty(
+            (indices.numel(), heads, 192), device=gathered.device, dtype=dtype
+        )
+        v = torch.empty(
+            (indices.numel(), heads, 128), device=gathered.device, dtype=dtype
+        )
+        kwargs = (
+            {}
+            if output_scales is None
+            else {
+                "k_out_scale": output_scales[:1],
+                "v_out_scale": output_scales[1:],
+            }
+        )
+        if indices.numel():
+            gather_kv_b_proj_flydsl(
+                gathered.view(-1, 1, 576),
+                cache_scale,
+                None,
+                indices,
+                None,
+                params.weight,
+                params.scale,
+                k,
+                v,
+                weight_preshuffle=params.preshuffled,
+                **kwargs,
+            )
+    if output_scales is None:
+        return k, v
+    return k, v, output_scales[:1], output_scales[1:]
+
+
+def use_fp8_context(max_query_len: int, max_seq_len: int) -> bool:
+    # Short calls do not amortize Q quantization and FP8 FMHA dispatch.
+    return max_query_len >= 512 and max_seq_len >= 8192
+

+class FP8PrefillContext:
+    """Q and projection descales owned by one layer's prefill forward."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        from aiter.ops.flydsl import flydsl_flash_attn_fp8_func
+
+        self.attention = flydsl_flash_attn_fp8_func
+        self.queries: dict[tuple, tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]] = {}
+        self.gather_scales: torch.Tensor | None = None
+
+    def prepare(self, q: torch.Tensor, k: torch.Tensor, v: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        with torch.accelerator.device_index(q.device.index):
+            quant = fused_qkv_per_tensor_quant(q, k, v)
+            key = (q.data_ptr(), tuple(q.shape), tuple(q.stride()))
+            self.queries[key] = (quant[0], quant[3])
+            self.gather_scales = torch.cat((quant[6], quant[7]))
+
+    def run(
+        self,
+        chunk: "MLACommonPrefillMetadata.ContextChunk",
+        q: torch.Tensor,
+        kv8: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor],
+        scale: float,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        with torch.accelerator.device_index(q.device.index):
+            key = (q.data_ptr(), tuple(q.shape), tuple(q.stride()))
+            cached = self.queries.get(key)
+            if cached is None:
+                # Quantize each distinct slice independently.
+                quant = fused_qkv_per_tensor_quant(q, q[:0], q[:0, :, :128])
+                cached = quant[0], quant[3]
+                self.queries[key] = cached
+            q8, qs = cached
+            k8, v8, ks, vs = kv8
+            return self.attention(
+                q8,
+                k8,
+                v8,
+                softmax_scale=scale,
+                cu_seqlens_q=chunk.query_start_loc,
+                cu_seqlens_kv=chunk.cu_seq_lens,
+                max_seqlen_q=chunk.max_query_len,
+                max_seqlen_kv=chunk.max_seq_len,
+                cross_seqlen=True,
+                causal=False,
+                return_lse=True,
+                q_descale=qs,
+                k_descale=ks,
+                v_descale=vs,
+                out=None,
+                stream=None,
+            )
+
+
+def compute_context(
+    impl: "AiterMLAImpl",
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    cache: torch.Tensor,
+    metadata: "AiterMLAMetadata",
+    k_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    state: FP8PrefillContext,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    assert metadata.prefill is not None
+    prefill = metadata.prefill
+    backend = prefill.prefill_backend
+    chunked = prefill.chunked_context
+    row_groups = metadata.dcp_context_row_indices
+    params = impl._flydsl_fp8_projection
+    assert backend is not None and chunked is not None
+    assert chunked.dcp_manager is not None
+    assert params is not None and row_groups is not None
+    assert state.gather_scales is not None
+    assert len(chunked.chunks) == len(row_groups)
+    output = output_lse = None
+    for chunk, row_indices in zip(chunked.chunks, row_groups):
+        gathered = gather_compressed_context(
+            cache,
+            chunked.workspace,
+            prefill.block_table[chunk.request_slice],
+            chunk,
+            chunked.dcp_manager.kv_gather,
+            torch.float8_e4m3fn,
+        )
+        query = q[chunk.token_slice]
+        if use_fp8_context(chunk.max_query_len, chunk.max_seq_len):
+            kv8 = project(
+                gathered,
+                k_scale,
+                row_indices,
+                params,
+                impl.num_heads,
+                state.gather_scales,
+            )
+            attn_output, attn_lse = state.run(chunk, query, kv8, impl.scale)
+        else:
+            k, v = project(gathered, k_scale, row_indices, params, impl.num_heads)
+            attn_output, attn_lse = backend.run_prefill_context_chunk(
+                chunk,
+                query,
+                k,
+                v,
+            )
+        if output is None:
+            if len(chunked.chunks) == 1 and not chunked.empty_token_slices:
+                return attn_output, attn_lse
+            output, output_lse = init_mla_context_partial(
+                chunked,
+                attn_output,
+                attn_lse,
+                num_tokens=q.shape[0],
+            )
+        accumulate_mla_context_chunk(
+            chunk,
+            attn_output,
+            attn_lse,

+        strides,
+        parts,
+        block,
+        single_pass,
+        num_warps=4,
+    )

+        token = offsets // (heads * dim)

+        nope_dim = dim - ROPE_DIM

+            + head * ROPE_STRIDE[1]
